product.title: MY MAGIC BUSY BOOK
product.subtitle: 36 Little Missions to Match, Sort, Count & Play!

missions.title: RAINBOW RESCUE
missions.instr: Match each raindrop to its cloud!
missions.goal: Recognise and name six colours; match by colour and symbol
missions.guide: Name each colour together. If colours are tricky, match the white symbols instead (heart, circle, star, leaf, wave, diamond).

missions.title: SHAPE DETECTIVES
missions.instr: Find the shape that fits each shadow!
missions.goal: Recognise circle, square, triangle, rectangle and star
missions.guide: Trace each outline with a finger and count the corners together. A circle has no corners!

missions.title: ICE CREAM SHOP
missions.instr: Make each ice cream match the order!
missions.goal: Follow a picture order; match colours; place items bottom-to-top
missions.guide: Read each order ticket from the bottom up. Afterwards, invite your child to invent their own ice cream.

missions.title: COLOUR SORTING GARDEN
missions.instr: Draw a line from each flower to its pot!
missions.goal: Sort objects into groups by colour
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Use a finger, a crayon or (if laminated) a dry-erase pen. Each pot shows a symbol as well as a colour.

missions.title: FINISH THE PATTERN
missions.instr: What comes next? Circle it!
missions.goal: Continue simple AB and AAB repeating patterns
missions.guide: Say the pattern aloud together ('red, blue, red, blue...'). Clapping or tapping the rhythm helps.

missions.title: BUILD A FUNNY ROBOT
missions.instr: Stack the pieces to build a robot!
missions.goal: Build a whole picture from parts; top / middle / bottom vocabulary
missions.guide: Once the robot is built, try a silly order on the table (wheels on top!) and talk about what changed.

missions.title: FIND MY HOME
missions.instr: Help each animal find its home!
missions.goal: Match animals to habitats; habitat vocabulary
missions.guide: Talk about each place: Is it wet or dry? Hot or cold? Many animals can live in more than one kind of place.

missions.title: WHAT DO I EAT?
missions.instr: Draw a line from each animal to its food!
missions.goal: Match animals with a food they really eat
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Each animal eats other foods too - this page shows one favourite. Pets should only eat food made for them.

missions.title: ANIMAL SHADOW SEARCH
missions.instr: Match each animal to its shadow!
missions.goal: Visual discrimination: match an outline to a picture
missions.guide: Uses the same animal cards as Mission 07. Look at ears, tails and feet to tell the shadows apart.

missions.title: MISSING ANIMAL PARTS
missions.instr: Find the missing part!
missions.goal: Notice what is missing; animal body-part vocabulary
missions.guide: Ask 'What is missing?' before showing the pieces. The dashed lines show where each part goes.

missions.title: FARMYARD FRIENDS
missions.instr: Put each farm friend in its place!
missions.goal: Match farm animals to where they like to be
missions.guide: Hens rest in the hen house, pigs cool off in mud and ducks love the pond. Make the animal sounds together!

missions.title: OCEAN EXPLORERS
missions.instr: Place each sea friend in the ocean!
missions.goal: Ocean-animal vocabulary; match shapes to outlines; story play
missions.guide: After placing the animals, make up a story: Where is the turtle swimming to?

missions.title: NUMBER TRAIN
missions.instr: Put the numbers in order, 1 to 10!
missions.goal: Recognise numerals 1-10 and put them in order
missions.guide: Start with 1 to 5 for younger children. The small grey numbers can be covered with paper for an extra challenge.

missions.title: COUNT THE BALLOONS
missions.instr: Count the balloons. Find the number!
missions.goal: Count up to 6 objects and match the quantity to a numeral
missions.guide: Touch each balloon once while counting aloud. Uses number cards 1-6 (shared with Missions 13, 16, 18 and 36).

missions.title: FEED THE MONSTER
missions.instr: Give the monster the right number of cookies!
missions.goal: Count out a set of 2, 3 or 5 objects
missions.guide: Play one order at a time. Put the cookies on the plate, count them together, then 'feed' the monster and start again.

missions.title: LITTLE NUMBER BAKERY
missions.instr: Count the cupcakes. Add the number!
missions.goal: Count 7 to 10 objects arranged in rows of five
missions.guide: Each full row has 5 cupcakes. Count the full row, then keep counting: 'five... six, seven'. Uses number cards 7-10.

missions.title: MORE OR LESS?
missions.instr: Circle the group with MORE!
missions.goal: Compare two groups and say which has more
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Count each side together, or line the pictures up with a finger to compare.

missions.title: BUILD A NUMBER TOWER
missions.instr: Build towers from 1 at the bottom!
missions.goal: Order numerals from smallest to largest
missions.guide: Easier: build only the 1-5 tower (it shows helper dots). Challenge: build the 6-10 tower too.

missions.title: DRESS FOR THE WEATHER
missions.instr: What should Leo wear today?
missions.goal: Connect clothing choices to sunny, rainy and cold weather
missions.guide: Look out of the window together. Which piece would you choose today?

missions.title: MAKE A HAPPY FACE
missions.instr: Change Leo's eyes and mouth!
missions.goal: Explore how faces can show feelings
missions.guide: There is no wrong answer. Try different eyes and mouths and ask 'How might Leo feel now? When do you feel like that?'

missions.title: HOW DO I FEEL?
missions.instr: Draw a line from each face to a feeling word!
missions.goal: Name common feelings
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Read the words aloud. Faces can mean different things to different people - talk about other ideas too.

missions.title: WASH, BRUSH, GET READY!
missions.instr: Put the morning cards in order!
missions.goal: Sequence four everyday steps; first / next / last
missions.guide: Every family's morning is different. The answer key shows one common order - any order your child can explain is fine.

missions.title: MY TEDDY'S OUTFIT
missions.instr: Dress Teddy for a cosy day out!
missions.goal: Clothing vocabulary; head / body / feet
missions.guide: Ask where each piece goes on our own bodies. Teddy can wear anything they like for pretend play too!

missions.title: KINDNESS GARDEN
missions.instr: Draw a line to a kind way to help!
missions.goal: Think about kind and helpful actions
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Read each situation aloud. Ask: 'What else could we do to help?' - there are many kind answers.

missions.title: MY LITTLE SUPERMARKET
missions.instr: Put each food on the right shelf!
missions.goal: Sort foods into three simple groups
missions.guide: Fruit & veg, bakery and dairy are common supermarket groups. Play shop afterwards!

missions.title: PACK MY BACKPACK
missions.instr: Circle the things to take to preschool!
missions.goal: Decide which objects are useful for a day out
missions.guide: No cutting needed. The bathtub, sofa and piano are silly choices - enjoy the giggles!

missions.title: WHAT GOES WHERE?
missions.instr: Find the room for each thing!
missions.goal: Match household objects to rooms
missions.guide: Walk around your home and find these rooms together.

missions.title: LITTLE CHEF'S KITCHEN
missions.instr: Follow the recipe to build a sandwich!
missions.goal: Follow a picture recipe in order (1, 2, 3)
missions.guide: Point to each step of the recipe card in order. Afterwards make a real snack together if you like.

missions.title: ON THE ROAD
missions.instr: Where does each vehicle go?
missions.goal: Match vehicles to sky, road, railway and water
missions.guide: Make the vehicle sounds together! Talk about which vehicles you have seen.

missions.title: MY DAY, MY WAY
missions.instr: When do you do these? Draw a line!
missions.goal: Morning, daytime and evening vocabulary
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Every family's day is different - accept any answer your child can explain.

missions.title: TREASURE MAP MATCH
missions.instr: Put each landmark on the map!
missions.goal: Match pictures to outlines on a simple map
missions.guide: Follow the dotted path with a finger from the bridge to the treasure.

missions.title: BUILD A LITTLE CASTLE
missions.instr: Add the roofs, the door and the flag!
missions.goal: Complete a picture with shape pieces; triangle and arch shapes
missions.guide: Name the shapes together: triangle roofs, an arch door, a flag.

missions.title: WHAT COMES NEXT?
missions.instr: Circle what happens next!
missions.goal: Simple visual sequences: first, next, last
missions.guide: No cutting needed. Tell each story aloud: 'First... then... next...'.

missions.title: NATURE DISCOVERY
missions.instr: Draw a line to the right basket!
missions.goal: Sort natural objects: leaves, flowers and stones
missions.guide: No cutting needed. On a walk, look at (but do not pick) leaves, flowers and stones together.

missions.title: FIND THE PAIRS
missions.instr: Turn over two cards. Do they match?
missions.goal: Visual memory and turn-taking
missions.guide: Start with the cards face-up for younger children. Use only 2 or 3 pairs at first.

missions.title: GRAND FINALE: HELP LEO GET HOME
missions.instr: Finish every stop to get Leo home!
missions.goal: Combine colour, shape, counting and picture matching
missions.guide: Uses cards from earlier missions: the blue drop (RD5), the star (SH5), number card 4 (NU4) and the penguin (AN4).

3: About 30–45 minutes to prepare. You only need to do it once – the pieces can be reused again and again.

WARNING: Contains detachable paper pieces. Not suitable for children under 3 years. An adult must print, cut and prepare all pieces, and supervise play at all times. Paper can tear into small bits: check pieces before each use and throw away any torn, wet or chewed pieces. Keep pieces away from children who put objects in their mouths. Use only flat fasteners (reusable adhesive or hook-and-loop dots) – never pins, staples, magnets, beads or cords. Store pieces out of reach after play. This is a printable learning activity, not a certified toy.

• Just starting (about 3): offer 2–3 pieces at a time, point and name together, and help place them.
• Growing (about 4): try a whole board, count aloud, take turns and talk about choices.
• Confident (about 5): invent new patterns, explain answers, try the 6–10 tower and play memory with all pairs.
• Every child develops at their own pace – repeat favourites, skip ahead or come back later.

• Keep each cut-out sheet's pieces in its own labelled envelope or zip bag (Sheet 1–5).
• Shared pieces (RD, SH, AN, NU) are used on several pages – return them to their envelope after play.
• Store the book flat in a folder; keep pieces out of reach of younger children.

• Print at Actual size / 100% (not 'fit to page') so the cards fit the boards.
• Use the US Letter PDF for Letter paper and the A4 PDF for A4 paper.
• Card stock (160–220 gsm) is sturdier. Print only the pages you need; reprint pieces any time for household use.

My Magic Busy Book is a 48-page printable activity book for ages 3–5 with adult help. Six little worlds hold 36 missions to match, sort, count, build and imagine. Five cut-out sheets supply reusable paper pieces that are shared across the boards, and 10 missions need no cutting at all.
Print at Actual size / 100% on US Letter or A4 paper. Card stock and lamination are optional.
Not suitable for children under 3. Contains detachable paper pieces. An adult must prepare all pieces and supervise play.
For personal / single-household use only. You may print copies for your own household. Do not resell, share or redistribute the files.
